timeline.text: Running payroll shouldn't mean chasing down your whole team. Missing hours. Unassigned expenses. Numbers that don't add up.
Meet PayrollPilot. Your AI payroll team.
PayrollPilot pulls your pay period from Jobber, QuickBooks and Gusto.
It audits every record, finds what's missing, and works out who actually knows the answer.
Audit hands the case to Resolution, which drafts one grouped question for the Ops lead.
You approve the exact text: a human decision, made in a shared room in Band.
A real iMessage goes out. In test mode, only to the owner's own phone.
A vague yes isn't an answer. It's flagged as ambiguous, and one clear follow-up goes out.
Then the answer comes back clear.
It proposes the fix. Wages stay the same. Two hundred dollars of job cost moves from Job 01 to Job 02.
After Approve and Apply, Payroll Preparation recalculates, and only the affected line changes.
Under the hood, three agents, Audit, Resolution and Payroll Preparation, hand off in one shared room in Band.
Every case moves across the work board from to-do to done, and Band tracks each agent's sessions, tokens and estimated cost.

And it remembers the business. The confirmed answer is written to Cognee. On memory recall after a restart, it no longer asks the Ops lead. It proposes the allocation to Job 02, and creates no approval.
You get one recap: wages and each payout, shown separately. You confirm the draft. Submitting stays with you.
From missing information to payroll-ready. With you in control.
